params.body:
The production studio still deployed to `peugeot-de-backer.sanity.studio`, the name from before the rebrand. `studioHost` in `studio/target.ts` now gives `stockcars` for production; staging stays `stockcars-staging`.

This takes effect on the next `npm run deploy` in `studio/`. That deploy creates the studio at `stockcars.sanity.studio` and does not remove the old one: `peugeot-de-backer.sanity.studio` keeps working until it is deleted under Studios in the Sanity manage UI. If the name `stockcars` is already taken by another Sanity project, the deploy says so and nothing changes.

The README table lists the new host. The npm package name (`peugeot-de-backer-studio`) is internal and left alone.
params.title: Deploy the production studio to stockcars.sanity.studio
